browser: Existing Chromium 1234 build; see browser getVersion in QA package
method: Persistent CDP session holds exact CSS viewport; each document scrolled across all positions to activate lazy assets. Screenshots internally generated, local ignored scratch only. Machine visibility checks supplement actual reviewer image inspection.

images.alt: The Ember Vault drops beneath one chain bridge; Elian and Mira are small adult silhouettes crossing toward the sealed bell lift.
One orange pulse travels upward through the chain and lifts dust against gravity.
Elian finds a bright straight shear face inside otherwise old rounded bridge wear.
Elian watches the sealed lift while his weak starting state is shown in reserved negative space.
Mira asks whether the shear is old; Elian identifies it as a clean opening.
Mira confirms that Elian still has both Iron Seals as his thumb moves toward them.
The bridge drops half a link; Mira catches the rail and Elian catches her spear shaft in a practiced response.
They release each other's gear; the intact Spark Talisman blinks behind two untouched Iron Seals.
Belljaw Warden climbs onto the far platform and opens the orange seam of its bell-shaped jaw.
The Level 6 custodian fills the bridge mouth while a narrow threat plate identifies its load response.
Elian tracks jaw, shoulder, forefeet, and anchor while visibly holding his breath.
Belljaw is right, Mira center-left, Elian behind, intact anchor below-left, and the sealed lift beyond the boss.
Mira locks her rear boot behind a crossbar and forms the Bastion Lancer T-silhouette.
Belljaw launches right-to-left and punches one foreclaw through a bridge plank.
The broken plank flips into the void and the intact anchor jerks upward under transferred load.
Mira plants shield and spear with hands, grip, and footing unobstructed.
Belljaw's jaw strikes Mira's shield wedge at one clear point; her planted boot skids but holds.
Belljaw clamps Mira's Dark-Teal Spear below the head instead of recoiling.
Belljaw wrenches the captured spear; Mira rotates with it to preserve her wrists and weapon.
Elian reaches past Mira's right shoulder and begins a deliberate jaw-to-ankle Fault Sight scan.
Fault Sight reveals one hairline near-ankle stress seam under the jaw load.
The load path from jaw through shoulder to ankle remains visible for six seconds.
Mira gives Elian four useful seconds while her forearms tremble under Belljaw's load.
Elian slides left-to-right beneath the jaw using the chain rail as one step toward the ankle.
Belljaw's free forelimb folds at an unexpected second joint and rotates toward Elian.
The forelimb backhands Elian before his Hooked Shortblade reaches the seam; his body flies toward a hanging chain.
Elian's left ribs hit a hanging chain and his breath leaves in one white burst.
Elian catches the chain; his tethered blade hangs safely while the Ledger confirms damage and Cracked Rib.
Elian hangs against a broad void guarding the left rib as the collarbone fissure closes.
Mira holds Belljaw and orders Elian not to turn the injury into a plan.
Elian's attempted inhale lights the collarbone circuit, which folds inward and dies.
Elian's fingers find the unique Spark Talisman while both Iron Seals remain locked behind it.
Mira identifies the talisman as the Chainworks exit plan; Elian chooses to spend it without claiming her permission.
Elian crushes the Spark Talisman; heat enters only his collarbone circuit while both Iron Seals remain untouched.
Elian inhales toward the right collarbone and opens one thin ember fissure.
Pressure drops collarbone to sternum, buckles around the cracked rib, then exits the diaphragm at a 30-Qi cost.
Two restrained breath pulses stabilize Elian's collarbone fissure as Breath Seed II opens and Fault Step becomes compatible.
The glow recedes and one Overburn fleck damages Elian after the breakthrough.
Belljaw unloads the near ankle; the visible fault closes as Mira's spear begins to slip free.
Mira rotates with the wrench, drops shield under jaw, and plants the spear butt to load the ankle once.
Elian recognizes that Mira's planted line recreates the verified ankle fault.
Elian activates Fault Step along the verified structural line; movement is acceleration, not teleportation.
Mira drives left-to-right while Elian launches bottom-to-top; both vectors converge on the orange ankle seam.
Hooked Shortblade and Mira's redirected jaw load split the ankle plate at one clear point.
Belljaw folds and crashes away from the intact anchor while Elian lands guarding his rib; Overburn ticks a second time.
Mira keeps the spear on Belljaw until the jaw seam goes dark; Elian watches the forelimb remain still.
A Rare Cinder-Key rests between two broken ankle plates beside Elian's unsteady knee and Mira's boot.
The Ledger verifies boss defeat, one intact anchor, quest completion, 85 XP, Level 4, and the Cinder-Key drop.
Mira binds Elian's cracked left rib with his coat lining and checks hands and breath without joking.
A pulse enters the intact anchor and travels upward toward the city while the clean shear face catches Elian's eye again.
The Cinder-Key displays Kiln Appraiser and Faultline Adept without selection as the far lift opens and Choose the Crack is offered.
Mira leads Elian into the lift at her pace; his injured side is protected and the Cinder-Key remains unbound in his open hand.

Elian hears the Bell Regent below and chooses to stay; tight mature close-up, jaw tense, green eyes tracking downward, quiet charcoal negative space upper left.
Mira decides not to order Elian away; freckled face softens without losing command, split shield edge at frame right, open space upper right.
Elian sits against one bridge anchor holding a cracked rib while Mira kneels at arm's length, anger masking fear; hands visible, restrained eye contact, open center-top.
Elian and Mira stand full-body back-to-back on a narrow chain bridge; every garment, belt capsule, hookblade, spear, shield strap, hand and boot readable.
Extreme close-up: Mira's left forearm locks the split shield hinge while her right hand adjusts spear grip; five fingers each, plausible wrist and hardware interaction, open upper-left field.

Elian, Mira, Orin and Sable share one tense platform; four distinct mature adult silhouettes and eyelines, no duplicated faces, open top band. Elian and Mira remain exact. Orin Pell is a broad compact 41-year-old light-olive forge-medic with graying dark hair, short boxed beard and rust-red apron. Sable Renn is a wiry 35-year-old fair cool-complexioned woman with amber eyes, black undercut, silver temple streak, fitted black-plum coat and segmented straight saber.
Vertical Ember Vault establishing view: tiny Elian and Mira cross one suspended chain bridge toward the sealed bell lift amid fired-clay ribs and geothermal depth; three clear depth planes.
Low camera looks up the Hollow Meridian crownshaft through repeating fired-clay ribs, black lift cable and two distant platforms; one tiny adult silhouette establishes scale, clean vanishing point.
Belljaw Warden emerges side-on from behind a kiln rib, iconic ivory shell, four black articulated forelimbs and bell jaw seam clearly readable, open upper-right field.
The towering Bell Regent climbs a vertical cable far below the city lift; original hollow bell torso, four long jointed legs and crown yoke, monumental but spatially clear.
Elian performs one low Fault Step left-to-right beneath Belljaw's jaw, hookblade aligned to the orange ankle seam; extreme foreshortening only along movement vector, grip and feet plausible.
Wide side view establishes the chain bridge: Belljaw at right charges left, Mira anchors center-left, Elian waits behind her, one intact anchor behind Elian; vectors unmistakable.
Belljaw clamps Mira's spear shaft and twists clockwise; Mira's planted boots slide but her shield stays between jaw and torso; clear physical contact and torque.
Elian crouches behind Mira and activates Fault Sight; exactly one hairline orange fault appears across Belljaw's front ankle, his gaze and free hand point to it.
Belljaw's forelimb backhands Elian into one hanging chain; impact bends his torso around the chain, hookblade remains in right hand, coat tears at left rib.
Immediate consequence: Elian on one knee grips his left rib, Mira still holds the jaw direction in deep background, intact anchor and fault line remain in their established places.
Payoff: Mira redirects Belljaw upward with shield and spear as Elian accelerates bottom-left to top-right and strikes the ankle seam; one clean converging impact, ceramic plate breaks away.
After the fight, Elian's coat is torn at the same left rib and his posture protects that side; Mira's spear is scuffed but straight, Belljaw ankle plate lies behind them.
Mira offers Elian a hand up; he looks at the hand before accepting, no smile, simple teal-black gradient and one out-of-focus chain, generous balloon space above.
Elian in three-quarter profile steadies his breathing against a plain kiln wall; large clean negative-space field at upper left for compact Status, XP and Level UI.
Elian studies the hookblade while one verified orange fault reflection crosses its edge; uncluttered negative space at right for Skill and Quest cards.
Top-down view of Elian's belt and open gloved palm holding one brass Cinder-Key; six physical slot tabs visible but blank, clean left field for deterministic Item and Inventory UI.
Elian exhales two deliberate ember pulses at his collarbone while Belljaw silhouette waits far across the bridge; negative upper band for Enemy and Cultivation interface.

Belljaw collapses beside the intact anchor while Elian and Mira remain readable at foreground left; controlled debris and three depth planes, reserve two separate quiet corners for dense but safe reconciliation UI.
The Ember Vault drops beneath one chain bridge; Elian and Mira are tiny adult silhouettes crossing toward the sealed bell lift.
Elian pauses in mature profile with one hand on the hooked shortblade while his weak starting status hangs in reserved negative space.
Elian and Mira trade a dry warning; the failing bridge anchor remains visible between their adult faces.
The ivory Belljaw Warden climbs onto the far platform and opens its bell-shaped jaw seam.
Side-on geography fixes Belljaw at the right bridge mouth, Mira center-left, Elian behind, and one intact anchor below.
Belljaw charges right-to-left and kicks bridge boards upward behind its foreclaws.
Mira plants the split shield and drives her spear into the charge line.
Belljaw clamps Mira's spear and wrenches it sideways while her planted boot skids.
Elian extends one hand; a single ember fault line reveals the boss's ankle seam.
Elian slides left-to-right beneath the jaw, using the chain rail as one step toward the ankle.
A ceramic forelimb backhands Elian into a hanging chain before his hookblade lands.
Elian hangs alone from the chain, guarding his cracked left rib as the collarbone ember fissure closes.
In an extreme close-up, Elian crushes his only Spark Talisman while two Iron Seals remain untouched at his belt.
Breath Seed II opens as one restrained ember ring; Elian coils against the chain with a newly stable breath.
Mira pins the bell jaw while Elian's Fault Step launches bottom-to-top through the ankle seam in one clear impact.
Belljaw lies collapsed inside the vault; Elian sits injured, Mira stands watch, and the Rare Cinder-Key rests in front.
Mira kneels to bind Elian's ribs while he tries and fails to stand without her help.
The intact anchor hums above the void as both adults assess the cost of retreating through unstable chainworks.
The Cinder-Key wakes a narrow class terminal showing two paths without selecting either one.
Elian studies the safer Kiln Appraiser option while Mira watches his breathing rather than the menu.
Mira presses one Iron Seal back into Elian's palm instead of letting him spend it on pain relief.
A distant bell pulse travels upward through the vault cables toward the public surface lift.
Elian and Mira step into the rising bell lift together, damaged gear and adult silhouettes clean against the pale door.
The lift closes on a new Ledger offer: choose a class and reach the Hollow Meridian crown before the Bell Regent ascends.
A monumental oxidized gate overlooks the Verdigris Sump, with one moving ivory seal suspended above dark teal water.
Sable Renn, a fair-complexioned adult Pathcutter in black-plum gear, stands beside a Level 7 Ash Crown status card.
Sable offers Elian a race to the seal and treats the public lift as acceptable collateral.
Claim the Verdigris Seal opens with one winner, no shared reward, and a visible reputation stake.
A Crownspike Bailiff's chest sigil slides from shoulder to sternum before the guardian fully wakes.
Sable cuts a straight Severing Lane across the first moving platform.
Elian and Mira sprint the lower route while Orin follows behind the shield line.
Mira vaults a turning pump arm and plants the split shield against the landing.
The tall ivory Bailiff drops between both routes and drives its crown spike into the platform.
Wide geography shows Sable above, Elian's party below, the seal beyond, and the Bailiff controlling the center.
Fault Sight marks the guardian's chest sigil at its first position.
Elian commits Rift Draw toward that static mark while Mira anchors the approach.
The sigil migrates to the opposite shoulder before contact, leaving no verified fault under the blade.
The Bailiff catches the hookblade wrist and rotates Elian into Mira's spear line.
Mira turns the spear to save Elian; the shaft bends against the crown spike.
The Bailiff hammers Elian shoulder-first into the oxidized gate.
A close view shows Elian conscious but unable to raise his left arm, with the Glass Lens cracked at his belt.
Sable uses the opening to take the Verdigris Seal as the guardian returns to its post.
The race quest changes to FAILED with no reward and a Free Delvers reputation loss.
Sable admits the shortcut was built to consume slower delvers and leaves anyway.
Orin reaches Elian and immobilizes the scapula while Mira stares at her bent spear.
Equipment condition cards show cracked Glass Lens, bent spear, intact hookblade, and severe shoulder injury.
Mira carries Elian through the kiln refuge door while Orin drags the bent spear behind them.
The end-state Ledger records 12/62 HP, 2/58 Qi, quest failure, faction shifts, and no unearned level-up.
The lower Verdigris sluice hangs beneath a cracked ceiling, with the pump heart visible through one distant arch.
The active pump quest and hidden three-catastrophe condition sit beside Elian's L6 Seed III status.
Orin checks his kiln satchel straps while warning that the ceiling fault is moving against the water load.
A Level 8 Collapse Hound steps onto the central beam, its counterweight tail reading the same ceiling crack.
Wide geography fixes the Hound above the secondary sluice, Mira below, Orin near the heart line, and Elian opposite.
The Hound bites a load-bearing seam and pulls the ceiling fracture toward the pump heart.
Elian reads the complete bite-pull-release pattern instead of striking the exposed jaw.
Mira braces the first falling slab away from Orin's route.
The Hound releases its counterweight tail and reverses the slab toward Mira.
Orin throws his kiln satchel clear of Mira; it falls into the acid water and burns away.
A whole ceiling plate begins to descend between the party and the pump heart.
Elian abandons the killing angle and Fault Steps to the seam that can divert the plate from Mira.
The three Pressure Breath circuits align from collarbone through sternum under the falling weight.
Breath Channel I opens as two controlled pulses route the moving fault away from the pump heart.
The Ledger offers Rift Temperer after three observed catastrophic patterns and the completed protection choice.
Elian accepts; Rift Mark I appears with its survive-pattern prerequisite, 22 Qi cost, 45s cooldown, and four-second duration.
He creates one temporary fault on the Hound's ceramic counterweight after surviving its full pattern.
Mira uses Bastion Arc to drive falling debris toward the temporary fault instead of across the party.
The ceiling breaks along Elian's marked line and buries the Hound while leaving the pale pump heart untouched.
The Hound's rear leg remains visible and still, while the secondary sluice collapses into dark water.
Keep the Pump Heart becomes COMPLETED_WITH_LOSS; the heart survives and the secondary sluice is permanently gone.
A Relic Rift Nail and Tempered Survey Bracer remain in the Hound's broken counterweight.
Mira tells Elian the class changed because his decision changed first; Orin mourns the lost satchel without melodrama.
L6 210/250 XP, Channel I, Rift Temperer, new gear, faction gain, and environmental loss reconcile.
The Bell Regent towers through the final chamber, four long legs spanning ivory platforms above the public lift cable.
Opening status shows Elian L7 300/320, 28/75 HP, 12/76 Qi, Channel I, injuries, Relic loadout, and active quest.
Elian assigns Mira the yoke, Sable the escape lane, Orin the lift cable, and himself the hostile note.
Wide geography fixes the Regent above, party on three platforms, public cable center, and the fourth-meridian door behind.
The Regent sounds one visible ring that bends every free cable toward its hollow face.
The central platform folds, forcing Mira and Sable onto opposite sides of the public cable.
Mira drives Crownfork into the crown yoke while Sable opens a Severing Lane under her injured arm.
The Regent lifts one leg and uses the skewed yoke to throw Mira across the cable.
Mira catches the cable with her shield hand; the bound left arm cannot lift the spear.
Elian reads two linked faults, one in the yoke and one in the note-distorted platform.
Two Crown Guards enter the lane; their defeat supplies 35 XP and crosses the Level 8 threshold once.
Level 8 raises HP/Qi maximums, grants one point, and carries 15/400 XP without clearing injuries.
Sable spends one controlled debt stack to cut a lane from Mira to Orin rather than toward the boss.
Orin anchors the rebuilt kiln line to the public cable and sends Suture Pulse to Elian.
After surviving the complete hostile note, Elian places Rift Mark on the Regent's nonliving yoke joint.
The Regent stamps through Elian's platform and breaks his route to the marked yoke.
Elian falls beside the public cable with the mark expiring above him.
Inside the second hostile note, Elian accepts its cadence and opens Breath Channel II in two restrained ember arcs.
A cultivation menu records the hostile-resonance gate, 76→86 max Qi, captured restoration, and Meridian Shear risk avoided.
Fault Step II follows the bent cable to Mira, then pivots at the linked yoke fault.
Mira, Sable, and Orin lock the cable and yoke so Elian's two-stage draw has one unambiguous target.
Rift Draw III severs the yoke and carries through the linked crown joint in the volume's clearest vertical spectacle.
The Bell Regent collapses away from the public cable; Crown Shard, Meridian Seal, and Sponsor Writ resolve with boss credit.
A CH01→CH10 comparison closes over the surviving lift as the sealed fourth-meridian door opens behind the adult party.
